customManagers.description: matrix.json's base image is a JSON string, not a Dockerfile ARG -- docker-bake.hcl always overrides the Dockerfile's own ARG BASE_IMAGE from it, so this is the only place a digest pin has any effect

Digest-pinned tool and registry images pulled through mirror.gcr.io (the BuildKit image of every builder in ci.yml, test-attest.sh's registries): the tag and digest are Docker Hub's, the mirror only serves them
test-attest.sh's zot registry, digest-pinned from GHCR (zot is not on Docker Hub, so not behind mirror.gcr.io)

packageRules.description: Auto-merge base image digest/patch refreshes once CI is green
Minor/major base bumps stay as PRs for review
Auto-merge the matrix.json base-image digest pin the same way as the Dockerfile bases
A new action release (minor/major) stays a PR for review
A mutable action tag can be force-moved to a malicious commit (the 2026-03 trivy-action hijack); a digest update waits a week and is never auto-merged, leaving a review window
Auto-merge action version-tag refreshes once CI is green (the SHA is pinned by hand from the new tag)

Never bump our own published images (ghcr.io/lotuswebagency/php(/corpus), lotuswebagency/php): a PR against either is a self-referential loop that changes a build input, invalidates INPUTS_HASH and triggers a rebuild producing a new digest to bump again
